passage.text: Emma, are you free? I need your help!
passage.reading: ˈɛmə, ər juː ˈfriː? aɪ ˈniːd jʊr ˈhɛlp!

passage.text: I bought a bag online last week.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈbɔːt ə ˈbæɡ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈlæst ˈwiːk.

passage.text: The photo looked great, and the price was only five hundred baht.
passage.reading: ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈlʊkt ˈɡreɪt, ənd ðə ˈpraɪs wʌz ˈoʊnli ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

passage.text: The bag arrived today, but it's a fake!
passage.reading: ðə ˈbæɡ əˈraɪvd təˈdeɪ, bʌt ɪts ə ˈfeɪk!

passage.text: The color is wrong, and the name on the bag is spelled wrong.
passage.reading: ðə ˈkʌlər ɪz ˈrɔːŋ, ənd ðə ˈneɪm ɑːn ðə ˈbæɡ ɪz ˈspɛld ˈrɔːŋ.

passage.text: I sent a message to the seller, but he didn't reply.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈsɛnt ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ tə ðə ˈsɛlər, bʌt hiː ˈdɪdənt rɪˈplaɪ.

passage.text: Now I can't find the seller online anywhere.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈkænt ˈfaɪnd ðə ˈsɛlər ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈɛniwɛr.

passage.text: I think it was a scam.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪt wʌz ə ˈskæm.

passage.text: Next time, I'll only buy items from big stores.
passage.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm, aɪl ˈoʊnli ˈbaɪ ˈaɪtəmz frəm ˈbɪɡ ˈstɔːrz.

passage.text: Can we go to the department store tomorrow?
passage.reading: kən wiː ˈɡoʊ tə ðə dɪˈpɑːrtmənt ˌstɔːr təˈmɑːroʊ?
